1.1.text:
ELUCIDATION
OF
REGIONAL REGULATION OF TAMBRAUW REGENCY
NUMBER 3 OF 2016
CONCERNING
PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE

I. GENERAL
The State has the obligation to provide Protection to every citizen in accordance with the preamble of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia. That Women and Children are vulnerable groups who tend to experience violence and therefore need to receive protection. Violence against Women and Children constitutes a violation of human rights and therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination.

Violence is any act unlawfully with or without the use of means against physical and psychological aspects that causes danger to life, body or results in the deprivation of a person's freedom. Furthermore, Violence against Women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in suffering or hardship for Women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against Children is any act against a Child that results in suffering or hardship physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and maltreatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of the Child. The existence of Women and Children Victims of Violence has not yet received adequate services and therefore minimum services for Victims of Violence are required.

In order to prevent and overcome Violence against Women and Children in Badung Regency so that they are protected from Violence, threats of Violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide Protection for Women and Children Victims of Violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.

This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for Women and Children Victims of Violence specifically in terms of services, monitoring and evaluation, reporting, funding, guidance and supervision of Women and Children Victims of Violence in Badung Regency.

II. ARTICLE BY ARTICLE
Article 1
Sufficiently clear.

CHAPTER I
GENERAL PROVISIONS
Article 1
In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by: Region is Tambrauw Regency.
Regional Government is the Regional Head as an element of Regional Government administration who leads the implementation of governmental affairs that are the authority of the autonomous region.
Regent is the Regent of Tambrauw.
Regional House of Representatives hereinafter abbreviated as DPRD is a regional people's representative institution that is positioned as an element of Regional Government administration.
Discrimination is any differentiation, harassment and exclusion that is direct or indirect based on human differentiation on the basis of religion, ethnicity, race, ethnic group, social status, economic status, gender, language, political beliefs that result in reduction, deviation or elimination of recognition, implementation or use of human rights and basic freedoms in life both individual and collective in the political, economic, legal, social, cultural fields and other aspects of life.
Violence is any act that results in or causes misery and suffering whether physical, sexual, psychological including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in public or in private life.
Violence against women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in misery or suffering of women physically, sexually or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether in the domestic realm or public in private life.
Violence against children is any act against a child that results in misery or suffering physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and maltreatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of the child.
Domestic violence is any act against a person, especially women, that results in misery or suffering physically, sexually, psychologically and or household neglect including threats to commit acts of coercion or unlawful deprivation of freedom within the household sphere.
Trafficking in Persons is the act of recruitment, transportation, harboring, sending, transfer, or receipt of a person by threat of violence, kidnapping, confinement, falsification, fraud and abuse of power or position of vulnerability, debt bondage or giving payment or benefits, so as to obtain consent from the person holding control over that other person, whether carried out within the country or between countries, for the purpose of exploitation or resulting in the person being exploited.
Child is a person who has not reached 18 years of age including a child in the womb.
Woman is an adult human of female gender and a person who is recognized by law as a woman.
Prevention is activities carried out to prevent the occurrence of acts of violence against women and children.
Protection is all service actions to guarantee and protect the rights of victims of acts of violence organized by the Integrated Service Center.
Physical violence is any act that causes pain, injury, wounds or disability to a person's body, miscarriage or fainting and or causes death.
Psychological violence is an act that causes fear, loss of self-confidence, loss of ability to act, distrust or severe psychological suffering to a person.
Sexual violence is any act in the form of sexual harassment, forced sexual relations, whether unnatural or unwanted with another person for commercial purposes and or certain purposes.
Victim is a woman and child who experiences acts of violence.
Service is immediate activities and actions carried out by professional personnel in accordance with their respective professions in the form of counseling, therapy and advocacy for the strengthening and recovery of victims of violence.
Assistance is activities and actions carried out by assistants during the service process.
Assistant is a person or representative from an institution who has the expertise to provide assistance.
Institution is an office/agency/body/within the scope of regional government and/or Non-Governmental Organization (NGO) that provides assistance.
Integrated Service Center hereinafter abbreviated as PPT, is an institution providing services to victims of violence based in hospitals, managed jointly in the form of medical services (including medico-legal), psychosocial and legal services.
Safe House is a temporary residence, provided to give protection to victims in accordance with predetermined standards.
Community is individuals, families, groups, social organizations and/or community organizations.
Integrated Service Center for Women and Children Empowerment hereinafter abbreviated as P2TP2A is an integrated service forum established by the Regional Government in the context of protection services for victims of violence against women and children in Tambrauw Regency.

Article 9
The obligations of family and/or parents as referred to in Article 6 letter c and letter d, who legally have full responsibility to prevent all forms of violence and protect women and children as family members.

Article 14
For the implementation of services for victims of human trafficking, the Regent of Tambrauw shall establish a task force on the criminal act of human trafficking.
The task force on the criminal act of human trafficking as referred to in paragraph (1) is a coordinating institution tasked with coordinating the prevention and handling of human trafficking.
Further provisions regarding the establishment, duties, and functions of the task force on the criminal act of human trafficking as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be stipulated by Regent's decree.

Article 15
In the context of preventing acts of violence against children including the protection of children from the worst forms of child labor, a committee for the elimination of acts of violence against children shall be established by Regent's Decree.
Further provisions regarding the duties and functions of the committee for the elimination of acts of violence against children as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be regulated by Regent's Regulation.

Article 10

opening of employment opportunities for women;
building community participation and concern towards the prevention and protection of women and children from acts of violence; and building networks and cooperation with law enforcement apparatus, government apparatus, universities and various non-governmental organizations that work and/or care about women and children.

That Women and Children are vulnerable groups who tend to experience violence and therefore need to receive protection. Violence against Women and Children constitutes a violation of human rights and therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination.

Violence is any act unlawfully with or without the use of means against physical and psychological aspects that causes danger to life, body or results in the deprivation of a person's freedom. Furthermore, Violence against Women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in suffering or hardship for Women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against Children is any act against a Child that results in suffering or hardship physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and maltreatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of the Child. The existence of Women and Children Victims of Violence has not yet received adequate services and therefore minimum services for Victims of Violence are required.

In order to prevent and overcome Violence against Women and Children in Badung Regency so that they are protected from Violence, threats of Violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide Protection for Women and Children Victims of Violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.

This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for Women and Children Victims of Violence specifically in terms of services, monitoring and evaluation, reporting, funding, guidance and supervision of Women and Children Victims of Violence in Badung Regency.

II. ARTICLE BY ARTICLE
Article 1
Sufficiently clear.

CHAPTER I
GENERAL PROVISIONS
Article 1
In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by: Region is Tambrauw Regency.
Regional Government is the Regional Head as an element of Regional Government administration who leads the implementation of governmental affairs that are the authority of the autonomous region.
Regent is the Regent of Tambrauw.
Regional House of Representatives hereinafter abbreviated as DPRD is a regional people's representative institution that is positioned as an element of Regional Government administration.
Discrimination is any differentiation, harassment and exclusion that is direct or indirect based on human differentiation on the basis of religion, ethnicity, race, ethnic group, social status, economic status, gender, language, political beliefs that result in reduction, deviation or elimination of recognition, implementation or use of human rights and basic freedoms in life both individual and collective in the political, economic, legal, social, cultural fields and other aspects of life.
Violence is any act that results in or causes misery and suffering whether physical, sexual, psychological including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in public or in private life.
Violence against women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in misery or suffering of women physically, sexually or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether in the domestic realm or public in private life.
Violence against children is any act against a child that results in misery or suffering physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and maltreatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of the child.
Domestic violence is any act against a person, especially women, that results in misery or suffering physically, sexually, psychologically and or household neglect including threats to commit acts of coercion or unlawful deprivation of freedom within the household sphere.
Trafficking in Persons is the act of recruitment, transportation, harboring, sending, transfer, or receipt of a person by threat of violence, kidnapping, confinement, falsification, fraud and abuse of power or position of vulnerability, debt bondage or giving payment or benefits, so as to obtain consent from the person holding control over that other person, whether carried out within the country or between countries, for the purpose of exploitation or resulting in the person being exploited.
Child is a person who has not reached 18 years of age including a child in the womb.
Woman is an adult human of female gender and a person who is recognized by law as a woman.
Prevention is activities carried out to prevent the occurrence of acts of violence against women and children.
Protection is all service actions to guarantee and protect the rights of victims of acts of violence organized by the Integrated Service Center.
Physical violence is any act that causes pain, injury, wounds or disability to a person's body, miscarriage or fainting and or causes death.
Psychological violence is an act that causes fear, loss of self-confidence, loss of ability to act, distrust or severe psychological suffering to a person.
Sexual violence is any act in the form of sexual harassment, forced sexual relations, whether unnatural or unwanted with another person for commercial purposes and or certain purposes.
Victim is a woman and child who experiences acts of violence.
Service is immediate activities and actions carried out by professional personnel in accordance with their respective professions in the form of counseling, therapy and advocacy for the strengthening and recovery of victims of violence.
Assistance is activities and actions carried out by assistants during the service process.
Assistant is a person or representative from an institution who has the expertise to provide assistance.
Institution is an office/agency/body/within the scope of regional government and/or Non-Governmental Organization (NGO) that provides assistance.
Integrated Service Center hereinafter abbreviated as PPT, is an institution providing services to victims of violence based in hospitals, managed jointly in the form of medical services (including medico-legal), psychosocial and legal services.
Safe House is a temporary residence, provided to give protection to victims in accordance with predetermined standards.
Community is individuals, families, groups, social organizations and/or community organizations.
Integrated Service Center for Women and Children Empowerment hereinafter abbreviated as P2TP2A is an integrated service forum established by the Regional Government in the context of protection services for victims of violence against women and children in Tambrauw Regency.

Article 15
In the context of preventing acts of violence against children including the protection of children from the worst forms of child labor, a committee for the elimination of acts of violence against children shall be established by Regent's Decree.
Further provisions regarding the duties and functions of the committee for the elimination of acts of violence against children as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be regulated by Regent's Regulation.

CHAPTER V
PREVENTION OF ACTS OF VIOLENCE
Article 10
To prevent the occurrence of acts of violence against women and children, the Regional Government conducts socialization, empowerment, and awareness-raising to families, parents, and the community by providing information, guidance and/or counseling.
In addition to empowerment and awareness-raising as referred to in paragraph (1), the Regional Government undertakes efforts as follows: improvement of the quantity and quality of education both formal and non-formal as well as informal;
opening of employment opportunities for women;
building community participation and concern towards the prevention and protection of women and children from acts of violence; and building networks and cooperation with law enforcement apparatus, government apparatus, universities and various non-governmental organizations that work and/or care about women and children.

CHAPTER VII
INSTITUTIONAL ARRANGEMENTS
Article 13
In the context of providing protection services to women and children victims of violence, the Regional Government establishes P2TP2A as an integrated service center for the protection of women and children from acts of violence including victims of acts of violence.
P2TP2A as referred to in paragraph (1) functions as an integrated service center in providing protection to women and children from acts of violence.
P2TP2A as referred to in paragraph (1) above consists of the Health Service, Hospital, Police, Social Service, Manpower Service, Women's Empowerment and Family Planning Service, Non-Governmental Organizations.
P2TP2A as referred to in the Community, Social Community Organizations, Higher Education Institutions in paragraph (3) shall be established by Regent's Decree.
P2TP2A of Tambrauw Regency in carrying out its duties and functions may coordinate with a network of service units and competent parties in undertaking efforts to protect women and children from acts of violence.

Article 10
To prevent the occurrence of acts of violence against women and children, the Regional Government conducts socialization, empowerment, and awareness-raising to families, parents, and the community by providing information, guidance and/or counseling.

BY THE GRACE OF ALMIGHTY GOD
REGENT OF TAMBRAUW,

Considering : that acts and treatment of violence against women and children constitute actions that violate the rights and dignity of women and children as human beings;

that the implementation of prevention and protection of women and children as victims of acts of violence in Tambrauw Regency has not been optimally carried out thus far;

that based on the considerations as referred to in letter a and letter b, it is necessary to establish a Regional Regulation concerning Protection of Women and Children From Acts of Violence;

In View of :

3.8.text:
Article 18
The Regional Government may provide financial assistance to community organizations, social organizations or non-governmental organizations that implement the protection of women and children from acts of violence and discrimination.
Financial assistance as referred to in paragraph (1), shall be in accordance with the regional financial capacity, and implemented in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations in the field of regional finance.

ELUCIDATION
OF
REGIONAL REGULATION OF TAMBRAUW REGENCY
NUMBER 3 OF 2016
CONCERNING
PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE

I. GENERAL
The State has the obligation to provide Protection to every citizen in accordance with the preamble of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia. That Women and Children are vulnerable groups who tend to experience violence and therefore need to receive protection. Violence against Women and Children constitutes a violation of human rights and therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination.

Violence is any act unlawfully with or without the use of means against physical and psychological aspects that causes danger to life, body or results in the deprivation of a person's freedom. Furthermore, Violence against Women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in suffering or hardship for Women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against Children is any act against a Child that results in suffering or hardship physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and maltreatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of the Child. The existence of Women and Children Victims of Violence has not yet received adequate services and therefore minimum services for Victims of Violence are required.

In order to prevent and overcome Violence against Women and Children in Badung Regency so that they are protected from Violence, threats of Violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide Protection for Women and Children Victims of Violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.

This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for Women and Children Victims of Violence specifically in terms of services, monitoring and evaluation, reporting, funding, guidance and supervision of Women and Children Victims of Violence in Badung Regency.

II. ARTICLE BY ARTICLE
Article 1
Sufficiently clear.

CHAPTER VII
INSTITUTIONAL ARRANGEMENTS
Article 13
In the context of providing protection services to women and children victims of violence, the Regional Government establishes P2TP2A as an integrated service center for the protection of women and children from acts of violence including victims of acts of violence.
P2TP2A as referred to in paragraph (1) functions as an integrated service center in providing protection to women and children from acts of violence.
P2TP2A as referred to in paragraph (1) above consists of the Health Service, Hospital, Police, Social Service, Manpower Service, Women's Empowerment and Family Planning Service, Non-Governmental Organizations.
P2TP2A as referred to in the Community, Social Community Organizations, Higher Education Institutions in paragraph (3) shall be established by Regent's Decree.
P2TP2A of Tambrauw Regency in carrying out its duties and functions may coordinate with a network of service units and competent parties in undertaking efforts to protect women and children from acts of violence.

GENERAL PROVISIONS
Article 1
In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by: Region is Tambrauw Regency.

Violence is any act that results in or causes misery and suffering whether physical, sexual, psychological including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in public or in private life.
Violence against women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in misery or suffering of women physically, sexually or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether in the domestic realm or public in private life.
Violence against children is any act against a child that results in misery or suffering physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and maltreatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of the child.
Domestic violence is any act against a person, especially women, that results in misery or suffering physically, sexually, psychologically and or household neglect including threats to commit acts of coercion or unlawful deprivation of freedom within the household sphere.
Trafficking in Persons is the act of recruitment, transportation, harboring, sending, transfer, or receipt of a person by threat of violence, kidnapping, confinement, falsification, fraud and abuse of power or position of vulnerability, debt bondage or giving payment or benefits, so as to obtain consent from the person holding control over that other person, whether carried out within the country or between countries, for the purpose of exploitation or resulting in the person being exploited.
Child is a person who has not reached 18 years of age including a child in the womb.
Woman is an adult human of female gender and a person who is recognized by law as a woman.
Prevention is activities carried out to prevent the occurrence of acts of violence against women and children.
Protection is all service actions to guarantee and protect the rights of victims of acts of violence organized by the Integrated Service Center.
Physical violence is any act that causes pain, injury, wounds or disability to a person's body, miscarriage or fainting and or causes death.
Psychological violence is an act that causes fear, loss of self-confidence, loss of ability to act, distrust or severe psychological suffering to a person.
Sexual violence is any act in the form of sexual harassment, forced sexual relations, whether unnatural or unwanted with another person for commercial purposes and or certain purposes.
Victim is a woman and child who experiences acts of violence.
Service is immediate activities and actions carried out by professional personnel in accordance with their respective professions in the form of counseling, therapy and advocacy for the strengthening and recovery of victims of violence.
Assistance is activities and actions carried out by assistants during the service process.
Assistant is a person or representative from an institution who has the expertise to provide assistance.
Institution is an office/agency/body/within the scope of regional government and/or Non-Governmental Organization (NGO) that provides assistance.
Integrated Service Center hereinafter abbreviated as PPT, is an institution providing services to victims of violence based in hospitals, managed jointly in the form of medical services (including medico-legal), psychosocial and legal services.
Safe House is a temporary residence, provided to give protection to victims in accordance with predetermined standards.
Community is individuals, families, groups, social organizations and/or community organizations.
Integrated Service Center for Women and Children Empowerment hereinafter abbreviated as P2TP2A is an integrated service forum established by the Regional Government in the context of protection services for victims of violence against women and children in Tambrauw Regency.

CHAPTER V
PREVENTION OF ACTS OF VIOLENCE
Article 10
To prevent the occurrence of acts of violence against women and children, the Regional Government conducts socialization, empowerment, and awareness-raising to families, parents, and the community by providing information, guidance and/or counseling.

opening of employment opportunities for women;

I. GENERAL
The State has the obligation to provide Protection to every citizen in accordance with the preamble of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia. That Women and Children are vulnerable groups who tend to experience violence and therefore need to receive protection. Violence against Women and Children constitutes a violation of human rights and therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination.

Violence is any act unlawfully with or without the use of means against physical and psychological aspects that causes danger to life, body or results in the deprivation of a person's freedom. Furthermore, Violence against Women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in suffering or hardship for Women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against Children is any act against a Child that results in suffering or hardship physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and maltreatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of the Child. The existence of Women and Children Victims of Violence has not yet received adequate services and therefore minimum services for Victims of Violence are required.

In order to prevent and overcome Violence against Women and Children in Badung Regency so that they are protected from Violence, threats of Violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide Protection for Women and Children Victims of Violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.

This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for Women and Children Victims of Violence specifically in terms of services, monitoring and evaluation, reporting, funding, guidance and supervision of Women and Children Victims of Violence in Badung Regency.

II. ARTICLE BY ARTICLE
Article 1
Sufficiently clear.

Article 18
The Regional Government may provide financial assistance to community organizations, social organizations or non-governmental organizations that implement the protection of women and children from acts of violence and discrimination.
Financial assistance as referred to in paragraph (1), shall be in accordance with the regional financial capacity, and implemented in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations in the field of regional finance.

CHAPTER V
PREVENTION OF ACTS OF VIOLENCE
Article 10
To prevent the occurrence of acts of violence against women and children, the Regional Government conducts socialization, empowerment, and awareness-raising to families, parents, and the community by providing information, guidance and/or counseling.
In addition to empowerment and awareness-raising as referred to in paragraph (1), the Regional Government undertakes efforts as follows: improvement of the quantity and quality of education both formal and non-formal as well as informal;
opening of employment opportunities for women;
building community participation and concern towards the prevention and protection of women and children from acts of violence; and building networks and cooperation with law enforcement apparatus, government apparatus, universities and various non-governmental organizations that work and/or care about women and children.

GENERAL PROVISIONS
Article 1
In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by: Region is Tambrauw Regency.
Regional Government is the Regional Head as an element of Regional Government administration who leads the implementation of governmental affairs that are the authority of the autonomous region.
Regent is the Regent of Tambrauw.
Regional House of Representatives hereinafter abbreviated as DPRD is a regional people's representative institution that is positioned as an element of Regional Government administration.

Violence is any act that results in or causes misery and suffering whether physical, sexual, psychological including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in public or in private life.
Violence against women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in misery or suffering of women physically, sexually or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether in the domestic realm or public in private life.
Violence against children is any act against a child that results in misery or suffering physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and maltreatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of the child.
Domestic violence is any act against a person, especially women, that results in misery or suffering physically, sexually, psychologically and or household neglect including threats to commit acts of coercion or unlawful deprivation of freedom within the household sphere.
Trafficking in Persons is the act of recruitment, transportation, harboring, sending, transfer, or receipt of a person by threat of violence, kidnapping, confinement, falsification, fraud and abuse of power or position of vulnerability, debt bondage or giving payment or benefits, so as to obtain consent from the person holding control over that other person, whether carried out within the country or between countries, for the purpose of exploitation or resulting in the person being exploited.

Woman is an adult human of female gender and a person who is recognized by law as a woman.
Prevention is activities carried out to prevent the occurrence of acts of violence against women and children.
Protection is all service actions to guarantee and protect the rights of victims of acts of violence organized by the Integrated Service Center.
Physical violence is any act that causes pain, injury, wounds or disability to a person's body, miscarriage or fainting and or causes death.
Psychological violence is an act that causes fear, loss of self-confidence, loss of ability to act, distrust or severe psychological suffering to a person.
Sexual violence is any act in the form of sexual harassment, forced sexual relations, whether unnatural or unwanted with another person for commercial purposes and or certain purposes.
Victim is a woman and child who experiences acts of violence.
Service is immediate activities and actions carried out by professional personnel in accordance with their respective professions in the form of counseling, therapy and advocacy for the strengthening and recovery of victims of violence.
Assistance is activities and actions carried out by assistants during the service process.
Assistant is a person or representative from an institution who has the expertise to provide assistance.
Institution is an office/agency/body/within the scope of regional government and/or Non-Governmental Organization (NGO) that provides assistance.
Integrated Service Center hereinafter abbreviated as PPT, is an institution providing services to victims of violence based in hospitals, managed jointly in the form of medical services (including medico-legal), psychosocial and legal services.
Safe House is a temporary residence, provided to give protection to victims in accordance with predetermined standards.
Community is individuals, families, groups, social organizations and/or community organizations.
Integrated Service Center for Women and Children Empowerment hereinafter abbreviated as P2TP2A is an integrated service forum established by the Regional Government in the context of protection services for victims of violence against women and children in Tambrauw Regency.

CHAPTER VII
INSTITUTIONAL ARRANGEMENTS
Article 13
In the context of providing protection services to women and children victims of violence, the Regional Government establishes P2TP2A as an integrated service center for the protection of women and children from acts of violence including victims of acts of violence.
P2TP2A as referred to in paragraph (1) functions as an integrated service center in providing protection to women and children from acts of violence.
P2TP2A as referred to in paragraph (1) above consists of the Health Service, Hospital, Police, Social Service, Manpower Service, Women's Empowerment and Family Planning Service, Non-Governmental Organizations.
P2TP2A as referred to in the Community, Social Community Organizations, Higher Education Institutions in paragraph (3) shall be established by Regent's Decree.
P2TP2A of Tambrauw Regency in carrying out its duties and functions may coordinate with a network of service units and competent parties in undertaking efforts to protect women and children from acts of violence.

I. GENERAL
The State has the obligation to provide Protection to every citizen in accordance with the preamble of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia. That Women and Children are vulnerable groups who tend to experience violence and therefore need to receive protection. Violence against Women and Children constitutes a violation of human rights and therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination.

This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for Women and Children Victims of Violence specifically in terms of services, monitoring and evaluation, reporting, funding, guidance and supervision of Women and Children Victims of Violence in Badung Regency.

Sexual violence is any act in the form of sexual harassment, forced sexual relations, whether unnatural or unwanted with another person for commercial purposes and or certain purposes.

Safe House is a temporary residence, provided to give protection to victims in accordance with predetermined standards.
Community is individuals, families, groups, social organizations and/or community organizations.
Integrated Service Center for Women and Children Empowerment hereinafter abbreviated as P2TP2A is an integrated service forum established by the Regional Government in the context of protection services for victims of violence against women and children in Tambrauw Regency.
